title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Marketing - Stating Fees
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal advertises "Complete Traffic Ticket Representation for $300!" However, the fine print of the retainer agreement reveals this does not include court filing fees or taxes. Is this advertisement compliant with LSO rules?
options: Yes, as long as it is clarified in the retainer agreement before the client signs.
Yes, marketing rules do not govern fee structures.
No, any advertisement of a fee must state strictly whether the fee includes disbursements and taxes.
No, paralegals are not permitted to advertise fixed prices for legal services.
questions.explain: Rule 8.03 on Marketing requires that when a price is advertised, it must be stated clearly whether disbursements and taxes are included. Hidden fees make the advertisement misleading and deceptive.
